markdown.markdown: *Applied mathematician* ::: {.intro} I am an applied mathematician working at the interface of nonlinear mechanics, elasticity, growth, and biological morphogenesis. My research develops mathematical models for how biological and soft material systems grow, deform, and control their shape. ::: ## Research topics ::: {.panel-tabset} ### Plant mechanics and morphogenesis I study the mechanics of plant shoots, with a focus on tissue tension, residual stress, growth, tropisms, and posture control. ### Neuronal growth I develop mathematical models for how local growth, remodeling, and mechanical feedback generate organ-scale shape changes in biological systems. ::: {.center} ![Caption](images/rod.png){width=60%} ::: ### Network models of brain degeneration I study transport, spreading, and clearance processes in biological networks, with applications to neurodegenerative disease models. ### Nonlinear elasticity and instabilities I work on nonlinear elastic phenomena including bifurcation, stability, and shape formation in soft solids and biological materials. ::: ## Selected publications **[Towards a hydromechanical theory of plant active matter](https://hal.science/hal-05623240v1)** H. Oliveri, C. Godin, and I. Cheddadi *Quantitative Plant Biology*, accepted, 2026 **[Hydromechanical field theory of plant morphogenesis](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0022509625000110)** H. Oliveri and I. Cheddadi *Journal of the Mechanics and Physics of Solids*, 2025 **[Active shape control by plants in dynamic environments](https://journals.aps.org/pre/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevE.110.014405)** H. Oliveri, D. E. Moulton, H. A. Harrington, and A. Goriely *Physical Review E*, 2024 **[Theory for durotactic axon guidance](https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.126.118101)** H. Oliveri, K. Franze, and A. Goriely *Physical Review Letters*, 2021 **[Multiscale integration of environmental stimuli in plant tropism produces complex behaviors](https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2016025117)** D. E. Moulton, H. Oliveri, and A. Goriely, *Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences*, 2020 [See all publications](publications.html)
